measurement: line-count ratchet: a measured runtime file may never exceed its recorded value; `ceiling` is the absolute bound that only an explicitly recorded decision may raise
history: v53.96/P895 (commit 6fd5289b, 2026-08-10) introduced fixed caps on three files. Those caps were never read from this file — the numbers were hardcoded in scripts/ci-decomp-hotspot-check.mjs, so the declaration and the enforcement could silently disagree. They also covered only 3 of 7 runtime files, so accretion escaped sideways into aio-ui/aio-chat/aio-tests, and at js/aio-core.js the cap sat 1 line above the file — a wall that blocked a one-line correctness fix instead of a ratchet. v56.61/P1291–P1298 records deliberate ratchet growth of js/aio-core.js (+3) and js/aio-data.js (+5) for strict millisecond-precision live-core freshness and future timestamp rejection, and js/aio-pages.js (+38) for escaped Risk Radar source labels and canonical official HTTPS links. These additions remove stale-input waivers and unsafe source rendering; include this rationale in the eventual release commit.

ceilingHistory.reason: The /relay client path, the three restored web-search credential inputs, the Claude server-key-mode toggle and the observed-vs-stored provider status added 54 lines. The previous 28000 sat one line above the file — the exact wall P1127 replaced with a ratchet — so the recorded decision is a raise with real headroom, not another near-boundary.

The legacy news sample guard adds 15 lines to reject sub-N signals and malformed synthetic scores at market-state, narrative, action-plan and loop-audit boundaries. Keeping the guard in the established compatibility path is required for F-52 closure; the previous 28200 ceiling was crossed by 7 lines, so this explicit 50-line window preserves readable regression coverage with 43 lines of headroom. The release commit remains pending strict data-refresh and approval boundaries.

The cumulative handoff fixes grew aio-core from 28210 to 28251 (+41), crossing the recorded absolute ceiling by one line. The growth carries executable safeguards for source-grounded macro events and calendars, strict millisecond freshness/future rejection, decision-grade news sample boundaries, and fail-closed cycle evidence. Keep a 50-line window so those contracts remain readable and the ratchet still catches further growth; do not raise this ceiling again without first evaluating extraction. Record this rationale in the eventual release commit after D0 data/lineage acceptance.
